candidate_selection: fixed set of 19 feature IDs with complete generated feature-intervention runs; no test data used for candidate selection
test_evaluation: candidate features evaluated only on test split; eyes and eyebrows contrasted with other face cells, ears contrasted with other image cells

eyes.bootstrap_method: stratified image bootstrap within race/gender categories; macro-average category contrast

eyebrows.bootstrap_method: stratified image bootstrap within race/gender categories; macro-average category contrast

nose.bootstrap_method: stratified image bootstrap within race/gender categories; macro-average category contrast

ears.bootstrap_method: stratified image bootstrap within race/gender categories; macro-average category contrast

interpretation: Positive held-out contrast supports spatial association with the annotated box, not a semantic feature label. Boxes are automatic and unreviewed.
